''See also: [[Overlord (Cradle) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Overlord is a significant stage of power and [[advancement]] within the world of [[Cradle]]. It represents a level of strength that surpasses an [[Underlord]], though it is noted that experienced or highly talented [[Underlord|Underlords]] may occasionally defeat less capable or newly advanced Overlords. Reaching this stage is often associated with a specific revelation, which involves a process of recognizing and refocusing one's identity through meditation on the present. This stage is considered a major advantage in combat, providing powerful techniques and [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]] that can shake vessels or influence the environment. Individuals at this level include [[Naru Huan]], the Emperor of the [[Blackflame Empire]], and various leaders or combatants across different kingdoms. The progression from [[Underlord]] to Overlord is a major milestone, though it remains a step below the [[Archlord]] stage. Some individuals may reach this level through rapid [[advancement]] or specialized training, and certain weapons or spiritual objects can possess power equivalent to an Overlord. While powerful, those at this stage may still face significant challenges when confronting higher-level entities like [[Dreadgods]] or [[Archlord|Archlords]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Eithan]] has the potential to reach this stage, though [[Mercy]] notes he is not performing much better without it. [[Lindon]] seeks advice on the rank and hopes to reach it via the [[Consume]] technique, while the [[Winter Sage]] expresses concern regarding [[Yerin]]'s [[advancement]]. Additionally, an Overlord was previously ruined by [[Eithan]] through spiritual damage.}}
